mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) signals robust economic growth that consistently supports corporate earnings and equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances with FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC remains negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates tightening policy amid labor market strength, triggering recession fears that drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with strong labor market
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of interaction events, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals manufacturing weakness that precedes earnings deterioration, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of late-cycle expansion periods with declining INDPRO, or Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months with rising PAYEMS, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1400.0 thousand units for two consecutive months, it signals weakening residential demand that typically precedes broader economic slowdown, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances with HOUST < 1400.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates broad-based economic contraction that triggers equity sell-offs, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of interaction events, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, a CPIAUCSL reading above 6.0% annually signals persistent inflation that necessitates further rate hikes, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during monetary tightening with CPIAUCSL > 6.0%, or Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.
